ScriptBlockEntity.description:
ScriptBlockEntity represents a block entity (tile entity) in the Minecraft world.
Block entities are special blocks that can store additional data and perform updates, such as chests, furnaces, or custom modded blocks.

Block entities maintain their own state and can interact with the world around them.
They are positioned at specific coordinates and can store custom data using NBT compounds.

methods.name: getMinecraftTileEntity
methods.description:
Returns the underlying Minecraft BlockEntity instance.

This method provides access to the native Minecraft block entity object,
which can be useful for advanced operations or compatibility with other mods.
methods.script:
const blockEntity = c.world.getBlockEntity(x, y, z);
const minecraftBlockEntity = blockEntity.getMinecraftTileEntity();

methods.name: getWorld
methods.description:
Returns the ScriptWorld instance containing this block entity.

Use this method to access the world for performing operations in the
context of this block entity's environment.

methods.name: getType
methods.description:
Returns the identifier type of this block entity.

The type is returned as a string in the format "namespace:name",
e.g., "minecraft:chest" or "minecraft:furnace"

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description:
Returns the position of this block entity in the world.

The position is returned as a ScriptVector containing the x, y, and z coordinates.

methods.name: markDirty
methods.description:
Marks this block entity as dirty, forcing a data save and sync.

Call this method after modifying the block entity's data to ensure
changes are properly saved and synchronized with clients.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description:
Returns the ScriptBlockState of the block associated with this block entity.

Use this to access or modify the block's properties and state.

methods.name: getNbtCompound
methods.description:
Returns the NBT compound containing this block entity's data.

The NBT compound contains all custom data stored in the block entity.

methods.name: setNbtCompound
methods.description:
Sets the NBT compound data for this block entity.

Use this method to update the block entity's stored data.
Remember to call markDirty() after setting new data.

Overview:
CubeCodeStates provides a persistent key-value storage system that can be accessed from both player and server contexts. It supports various data types and can be used to store game state information.

ClientCubeCodeUI.description:
ClientCubeCodeUI is a class that implements the CubeCodeUIBuilder interface, providing a user interface (UI)
Object for creating various UI components
This class serves as a bridge between the UI components and the underlying view, allowing for the creation and management of windows, buttons, text fields, and other interactive elements.
It encapsulates the behavior of UI components and manages their addition to the view, while also
providing utility methods for handling input events and layout management.

AbstractComponent.description:
AbstractComponent serves as a base class for creating and manipulating UI components
in a graphical user interface framework. It provides a fluent interface for setting
various properties of the component, including position, size, colors, transparency,
padding, and rounding. This class allows for a high degree of customization and
flexibility when designing UI elements.

methods.name: rx

Sets the X relative of the component.
If the Y relative (ry) is not set, it defaults to 0.

methods.name: y
methods.description: Sets the Y coordinate of the component.

methods.name: ry
methods.description:
Sets the Y relative of the component.
If the X relative (rx) is not set, it defaults to 0.

methods.name: xy
methods.description: Sets both the X and Y coordinates of the component.

methods.name: rxy
methods.description: Sets both the X and Y relative of the component.

methods.name: resetX
methods.description: Resets the X coordinate of the component.

methods.name: resetY
